Nora leaves for work around 12:00 (items removed: phone, keys, shoes, jacket, dog leash, laptop, bag). She returns around 20:00 (items reappear in entry/living). This suggests a late start or long commute, as she is home at 00:00, 04:00, and 08:00 patrols, but absent at 12:00 and 16:00.
Yuki remains home all day. Items move between desk, kitchen, and living room, indicating work/lunch/relaxation cycles.
The dog leash is taken out by Nora in the morning and returned by noon.
Yuki’s gym bag was removed Wed night and has not reappeared, suggesting it is currently OUT_OF_HOUSE or in a pocket/bag not scanned.
Nora’s work items (laptop, bag) were in entry Wed night, moved to living room Thu noon, and are now in entry.
